Hi Samantha / Raj,

Thanks again for the quick sync last week. To keep Week0 low-friction for your ops and stakeholder groups, we recommend a staggered attendee approach across two 90-minute blocks rather than a single large session. This reduces context switching and lets us run two targeted breakouts (Integration + Admin).

Proposed windows (Pacific time):
- Block A: Tue 2029-09-03 09:00–10:30 PT — Core platform + Admin (executive + product owners)
- Block B: Tue 2029-09-03 11:30–13:00 PT — Integration + SRE (engineering + infra contacts)

Why stagger: smaller groups for role-specific walkthroughs, faster access to logs & keys for engineers during the integration slot, and easier follow-up action items. If you prefer different days we can split across Tue/Wed.

Please confirm:
1) Which of these windows work for your teams?
2) Who will join each block (names + roles) so we can map hosts and breakouts?
3) Any mandatory attendees who must see both blocks?

Attached: Week0_Attendee_Roster.xlsx (fillable) and Orientation_Agenda_v2.docx (draft). I’ve also included a tentative bridge link — we’ll swap to your preferred meeting host if you want.

Next steps on our side: we’ll provision two dedicated call rooms, assign a primary host per block, and prepare the Integration checklist (pre-reqs for VPN/keys).

Thanks,
